conf.description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint alerts / json: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: defender-endpoint / alerts / json. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (Microsoft Defender XDR (m365_defender) integration, event data stream). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).

functions.description: record why this pipeline does not parse
tag the dataset before Elastic parses _raw
